intent: Offer one sourced extra fact and two questions: one about the subject and one about what to cover next.

templates.comment: One more detail: {verified extra fact}. {question about the subject}? {question about a future topic}?

examples: One more detail: {sourced detail omitted from the video}. What would make you trust a chatbot with a work file? What should we investigate next?
conventions: Sound like the person who made the video; stay under 420 characters.
Repeat the story’s central question when the narrative requires it; make the second question open.
sounds_false: Dear community, thank you for joining this incredible journey.
Do not forget to like and subscribe!

tone: Short sentences, everyday words, one person talking to another.
